description: This file defines a function `display_action_lines` in PHP for rendering action lines in SuiteCRM. It includes logic for loading JavaScript resources, including PHP files for actions, and generating HTML tables based on view modes ('EditView' and 'DetailView').

classes.name: AOW_Actions
classes.description: An implied class for action objects loaded dynamically within the function.

methods.name: display_action_lines
methods.description: Generates HTML and JavaScript for displaying and managing action lines associated with workflows, including dynamic inclusion of action scripts and rendering based on view mode.
